label: The Warmth of a Closed Room

lines.text: I try pulling the handle again and again,
Privaty calmly examines the area around the door.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I heard this storage room hasn't really been used in a long time.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Usually, Nikkes don't uses mats like these for class.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm guessing the room hasn't been maintained properly.
She runs her finger along the door and then looks at it. It's caked in dust.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's fine. We can just call another teach...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Uh-oh. I left my phone outside.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Mr. {AccountData.NickName}, could you use your phone to call someone?
... I think I left mine out there too.
You're gonna end up breaking the door like that.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Actually, that might not be a bad idea. I can just break down the door.
Someone will come looking for us. Let's wait a bit.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Damaging property would be cause more than a couple issues.
Unable to stand it any longer, I speak up.
I motion for Privaty to sit next to me on the mat where I'm sitting.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You want me to sit down with all this dust?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... Well, I guess there's nowhere else to sit.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And my legs were starting to hurt anyway.
Maybe next time try not to plop down so hard. It stirs up a lot of dust.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I didn't think it'd be this bad. ..*Cough!*
Privaty turns her head toward me to try and escape the dust.
I pull up my sleeve and cover her mouth.
As I do, it naturally ends up looking like Privaty is leaning into me for an embrace.
Privaty adjusts her position slightly and shifts away from me.
On such a small mat, though,
our hips are still touching as we sit there next to each other.
In the silence, the sound of our clothes brushing against each other feels painfully loud.
How long do you think we've been in here like this?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's another thing that having a phone would help with.
I sweat a lot during class. Now that it's cooling off, I'm starting to feel cold.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Maybe there's something I could cover you with...
She stands and looks around the storage room.
When you're cold, aren't you supposed to warm up by hugging someone?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Where did you even hear that...?!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: W-well, if you're that cold, I guess I don't really have a choice...!
Slowly, Privaty comes over and leans into my arms.
Our clothes might be getting in the way. I don't actually feel that much warmer.
Did you think I was joking?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I thought you were just messing around!
No, I've actually been getting colder for the last little while.
Privaty pushes me down onto the mat.
Wow, look at you being all assertive.
She starts unbuttoning my shirt, one button at a time.
She carefully wipes me with a towel,
and pulls me into an embrace.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're freezing... Why didn't you say anything sooner?!
Yeah, I think I am now that you're holding me.
Her slightly coarse clothes brush against my skin,
and I feel her weight press against me, rigid but gentle.
What do we do if someone comes and finds us like this?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I-it's not like we're doing anything weird...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'm just helping to get your temperature up since you're so cold...
I lift my arms and embrace Privaty.
I'm glad we got trapped here.
Getting stuck with the girl you like is something that just about every guy dreams of at least once.
You like me too, don't you, Privaty?
With my body warming up and my heartbeat nice and steady,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: This might not be the right time, but...
As Privaty jumps up, the warmth disappears.
I thought you said it wasn't anything weird!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: S-still, someone could get the wrong idea...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Help us! We're trapped inside here!
What were you about to say earlier?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Put your shirt on, or I'll never tell you!
Satisfied with seeing Privaty's face turn bright red, I put my shirt back on.

lines.speaker: securitymale
lines.text: Is someone in there? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Y-yes, we're here...! Please open the door!
The door opens with a clack.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yes. Thank you for your help.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The door just auto-locked on us. I'm guessing it hasn't been used in a while.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Someone should probably schedule an inspection.

lines.speaker: securitymale
lines.text: I see. Were you trapped in here this whole time?

lines.speaker: securitymale
lines.text: You know, there are emergency buttons for precisely such situations. We tell all the teachers about them.

lines.speaker: securitymale
lines.text: The one for this room is right here.
I don't think I ever heard about that.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text:
Th-that's right...!
... I did actually hear about it.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I must've forgotten in all the confusion.

lines.speaker: securitymale
lines.text: Well, good thing I found you before you were in here for too long.

lines.speaker: securitymale
lines.text: It's pretty hot in here, huh?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Anyway, thank you for helping us.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We should get going. A-after you, Mr. {AccountData.NickName}.
Having been luckily found by the guard before too much time passed,
we're able to return safely to our rooms.
I feel a mischievous urge rise up, and I stare at Privaty as she shouts at the door while I still haven't put my clothes on.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What are you doing...?! I told you to get dressed already!
Privaty rushes over and starts trying to force my shirt on me.

lines.speaker: securitymale
lines.text: Is someone in there? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: J-just a moment...! Please don't open it yet!
The door opens with a clack,
and the guard steps into the storage room.
